end.summary: Discussed that keeping school clean, green and safe is everyone's shared responsibility.
end.parentNote: Anika practised everyday ways to keep school clean and safe, including using dustbins and picking up personal litter. They also sorted examples of wet waste and discussed compost pits. Anika first said everything in a compost pit becomes soil, then corrected this by explaining that plastic and foil do not rot and can harm plants. At home, ask them to sort a few household items into wet and dry waste and explain why.
